stats.l: learning path on the CEFR scale

pains.title: Why a German interview is harder than you think

items.title: Warum wollen Sie bei uns arbeiten?
items.body: A simple question — yet thousands of Vietnamese candidates get it completely wrong, because they do not know German interview culture.

items.title: Clear pronunciation when calm, gone under pressure
items.body: Practising alone, nobody corrects you. In the real interview, stress makes you mispronounce the very words you learnt.

items.title: No idea what German HR expects
items.body: Germans value preparation, precision and a direct attitude — very different from interviews in Vietnam.

items.title: No safe place to practise
items.body: You cannot afford mistakes with a real recruiter. Practising with friends lacks expert feedback and German context.

how.title: Three steps to a successful interview

items.title: Pick your trade and level

path.goal: Default goal: B2 Goethe-Zertifikat — you can change it any time in your profile.

levels.name: Getting started
levels.body: Greetings, introducing yourself, numbers, simple everyday sentences.

levels.name: Advanced
